command:
set -eu
cp -a /etc/fstab /etc/fstab.pre-mount-hardening
awk '$2 != "/tmp" && $2 != "/dev/shm" {print}' /etc/fstab > /etc/fstab.mount-hardening
printf '%s\n' 'tmpfs /tmp tmpfs rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,relatime,mode=1777 0 0' 'tmpfs /dev/shm tmpfs rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,relatime,mode=1777 0 0' >> /etc/fstab.mount-hardening
install -o root -g root -m 0644 /etc/fstab.mount-hardening /etc/fstab
rm -f /etc/fstab.mount-hardening
systemctl daemon-reload
mount -t tmpfs -o rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,relatime,mode=1777 tmpfs /tmp
mount -o remount,rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,relatime /dev/shm

command:
set -u
for d in /tmp /dev/shm; do
  printf '#!/bin/sh\nexit 0\n' > "$d/.mount-hardening-exec-test"
  chmod 0755 "$d/.mount-hardening-exec-test"
  "$d/.mount-hardening-exec-test" >/dev/null 2>&1
  rc=$?
  printf 'NOEXEC_TEST target=%s exit=%s expected_nonzero=yes\n' "$d" "$rc"
  rm -f "$d/.mount-hardening-exec-test"
  mknod "$d/.mount-hardening-node-test" c 1 3
  dd if="$d/.mount-hardening-node-test" of=/dev/null bs=1 count=1 >/dev/null 2>&1
  rc=$?
  printf 'NODEV_TEST target=%s exit=%s expected_nonzero=yes\n' "$d" "$rc"
  rm -f "$d/.mount-hardening-node-test"
done
